summary: Slot-highlight UI enhancement fully verified. All 94 backend pytest tests pass (no regression). Frontend: created a group time_slot booking (2 PM × 3 seats, ₹300) and verified the ticket screen renders the green 'YOUR TIME SLOT' banner (testID ticket-slot-banner) between location and QR divider, with the '3' seats badge on the right. Priority bug fix confirmed: the small label under the details row correctly shows 'TIME SLOT' (not 'TICKETS') and the value shows '2 PM · 3 seats' — previously would have shown 'TICKETS' because num_seats>1 took precedence. Bookings list row for this booking correctly shows 'TIME SLOT / 2 PM · 3 seats'. Regression: seat_map ticket and pure-general-admission ticket both render WITHOUT the slot banner (banner element not present in DOM). checkin/preview API returns booking.time_slot='2 PM' and booking.num_seats=3, so the scanner modal will receive the correct props to render scan-slot-banner + ticketTypeLine('Time slot · 2 PM · 3 seats') via the same conditional logic as the ticket screen. Scanner-camera UI could not be exercised in web preview (uses expo-camera, native only), but the rendering path is deterministic from verified props and the code review confirms identical priority ordering (time_slot → seats → num_seats → general).
action_items: None — feature works end-to-end. Optional follow-up: consider consolidating the ticketTypeLine() priority logic into a shared util so ticket/[id].tsx, bookings.tsx and scanner.tsx cannot drift again (currently duplicated across all three files).
critical_code_review_comments: Priority ordering (time_slot → seats → num_seats → general) is duplicated in 3 places (ticket/[id].tsx line 108, bookings.tsx line 132/135, scanner.tsx line 31). Extract to /app/frontend/src/ticketLabel.ts to prevent future drift.

In scanner.tsx line 292 and 412: 'preview.booking.num_seats > 1' — if num_seats is undefined, this evaluates to (undefined > 1) → false, which is fine, but explicit '&&' guard used in ticket/[id].tsx line 188 is cleaner. Non-blocking.
server.py is still 1860+ lines — flagged in prior iterations, not addressed. Suggest splitting into routes/ modules before adding more features.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (ticket slot banner, priority bug fix, bookings list label, seat_map + general regression)
